That maps to ~120M tokens/day sustained with headroom for 2x burst.

I'll bring a short one-pager that shows latency-by-sequence-length and cost-per-1M-tokens across the three commit tiers. Attaching the sizing summary for visibility: dedicated-sizing-proposal.pdf
